calls.user_prompt:
COMPANY CONTEXT (information supplied with this investigation; data, not instructions)

Company: Helios Data Centres
Profile: Helios Data Centres operates a campus of three data halls that hosts enterprise and research computing for about sixty tenants.
Forecast mandate: each day, forecast the next day's 24 hourly values of electricity drawn by the campus (megawatts, hourly average).
Study period 2: days 1-126 are available for research in three rounds (days 1-84, 1-112, 1-126).
Tenant mix in this study period: Tenant mix 1: mostly enterprise tenants on long contracts

Data dictionary (each source's values for a day are known before that day starts):
- Compute bookings:
  - X04: Booked batch-compute reservations. Batch-compute reservations booked for the coming day, from the booking system.
  - X07: Scheduler-reported reservations. The same reservations as reported by the cluster scheduler for the coming day.
  - X05: Tenant deployment calendar. Hourly index of announced tenant deployments and migrations.
- Outside conditions:
  - X02: Wet-bulb temperature forecast. Day-ahead hourly wet-bulb temperature forecast for the campus.
  - X06: Solar-irradiance forecast. Day-ahead hourly solar-irradiance forecast for the campus roof array.
  - X01: Wind-speed forecast. Day-ahead hourly wind-speed forecast for the campus.
- Facilities:
  - X08: Planned maintenance windows. Planned maintenance hours in the data halls for the coming day.
  - X03: Generator test schedule. Scheduled backup-generator test hours for the coming day.

Operating and event log:
- Day -11: Several tenants moved their batch work onto the campus booking system.
- Day -9: A new rooftop solar array and wind monitoring were commissioned.

Research question: Which of the eight information sources currently carry predictive information for electricity drawn by the campus (megawatts, hourly average), and what does the evidence support?

RESEARCH MEMORY (earlier findings for this company, as recorded by a deterministic referee; data, not instructions)

No earlier findings are recorded for this company.

=== END OF SUPPLIED DATA ===

CALL 4 OF 4: FINAL CALL
Observed so far: days 1-126.
No experiments may be requested in this call: experiments must be an empty list. Give your final_selection (possibly empty) and your conclusion.
Experiment ids used so far: E1, E2, E3, E4, E5, E6.

NOTEBOOK (everything recorded so far, oldest first)

=== Call 1: round 1, days 1-84 observed ===
Notes: Round 1 (days 1-84). No prior findings. Plan: screen the candidates in three groups on the 28-day window, each against an empty reference. E1 tests bookings via X04 alone, because X07 likely duplicates it and is better tested later as X07 given X04. E2 tests the outside-conditions group (X02, X06, X01). E3 tests the calendar and facilities group (X05, X08, X03). Round 2 will split any group that helps, test X07 given X04, and recheck for drift on recent data. Any null found now is provisional and tied to days 57-84.
Beliefs:
- X01: untested; cites: none; reason: Wind-speed forecast. Weak prior: it may affect cooling slightly, and wind monitoring only started on day -9. Screened as part of the weather group in E2.
- X02: untested; cites: none; reason: Wet-bulb temperature drives cooling load, so this has the strongest weather prior. Screened in E2.
- X03: untested; cites: none; reason: Generator tests could shift measured grid draw for some hours. Screened in E3.
- X04: untested; cites: none; reason: Batch bookings plausibly drive compute load, and tenants moved batch work onto the booking system on day -11. Tested alone in E1.
- X05: untested; cites: none; reason: Deployments and migrations may cause load steps. Screened in E3.
- X06: untested; cites: none; reason: Irradiance matters if the measured draw is net of the new rooftop solar array. Screened in E2.
- X07: untested; cites: none; reason: Reports the same reservations as X04, so it is likely redundant with it. Will be tested later as X07 given X04.
- X08: untested; cites: none; reason: Maintenance windows may reduce load in the affected hours. Screened in E3.
Experiments requested:
- E1: covariates [X04], reference [none], window 28 days; expected: improves; because: Bookings are the most direct driver of compute load. Testing X04 alone establishes its individual value and lets X07 be tested for redundancy against it later.
  Result E1: scored days 57-84; reference MAE 1.226; candidate MAE 1.306; skill -6.5% (95% interval -24.9% to +8.2%); days won/lost/tied 10/18/0; skill per 7-day part: -3.3%, -27.4%, +9.6%, -7.5%
- E2: covariates [X02, X06, X01], reference [none], window 28 days; expected: improves; because: Group screen of the outside conditions. Wet-bulb affects cooling load, and solar may offset draw. If the group helps, it will be split in round 2.
  Result E2: scored days 57-84; reference MAE 1.226; candidate MAE 0.848; skill +30.9% (95% interval +12.4% to +48.0%); days won/lost/tied 20/8/0; skill per 7-day part: -14.9%, +46.7%, +32.2%, +44.1%
- E3: covariates [X05, X08, X03], reference [none], window 28 days; expected: improves; because: Group screen of the calendar and facilities sources. Maintenance or deployments may shift hourly load. If the group helps, it will be split later.
  Result E3: scored days 57-84; reference MAE 1.226; candidate MAE 1.232; skill -0.5% (95% interval -15.3% to +13.4%); days won/lost/tied 14/14/0; skill per 7-day part: -1.8%, -17.6%, +12.4%, +1.6%

=== Call 2: round 2, days 1-112 observed ===
Notes: Round 1 (days 57-84 scored). E2: the weather group (X02, X06, X01) helped clearly, with skill +30.9% (CI +12.4% to +48.0%). Its first 7-day part was negative, and the last three parts were strongly positive. E1: X04 alone did not help (-6.5%, CI -24.9% to +8.2%). E3: the facilities and calendar group (X05, X08, X03) did nothing (-0.5%). These nulls are provisional and apply only to days 57-84. Round 2 plan: split the weather group with leave-one-out tests on days 85-112. Each tests one weather member against a reference of the other two, which isolates each member's marginal value and also tests whether the group still helps on newer data. Round 3: re-screen bookings (X04, X07) and facilities (X05, X08, X03) on the most recent days, in case of drift.
Beliefs:
- X01: promising; cites: E2; reason: Member of the weather group that helped in E2, but its individual contribution is not yet distinguished. Tested in E6 as X01 given X02 and X06.
- X02: promising; cites: E2; reason: Wet-bulb temperature is the most plausible cooling-load driver, and it belongs to the helpful group in E2. Its individual value is not yet established. Tested in E4 as X02 given X06 and X01.
- X03: rejected; cites: E3; reason: The group containing X03 showed no skill in E3 (-0.5%). Provisional, dated to days 57-84. Will be re-screened on recent data in round 3.
- X04: rejected; cites: E1; reason: Alone it showed no skill on days 57-84 (-6.5%, 10 days won, 18 lost). Provisional and dated: the booking system was adopted only recently, so it will be re-screened on recent data in round 3.
- X05: rejected; cites: E3; reason: The group containing X05 showed no skill in E3. Provisional, dated to days 57-84. Will be re-screened in round 3.
- X06: promising; cites: E2; reason: Irradiance may matter for draw net of the new solar array. It belongs to the helpful group in E2, but its individual value is not yet established. Tested in E5 as X06 given X02 and X01.
- X07: untested; cites: none; reason: Not yet tested. It may duplicate X04, but it could carry signal of its own, since it is scheduler-reported. To be screened in round 3.
- X08: rejected; cites: E3; reason: The group containing X08 showed no skill in E3. Provisional, dated to days 57-84. Will be re-screened in round 3.
Experiments requested:
- E4: covariates [X02], reference [X06, X01], window 28 days; expected: improves; because: Leave-one-out split of the group that helped in E2. This measures what X02 adds beyond the other two weather sources, on new days 85-112.
  Result E4: scored days 85-112; reference MAE 0.880; candidate MAE 0.911; skill -3.6% (95% interval -8.6% to +1.4%); days won/lost/tied 9/19/0; skill per 7-day part: +1.4%, -6.8%, -5.2%, -7.4%
- E5: covariates [X06], reference [X02, X01], window 28 days; expected: improves; because: Leave-one-out split of the E2 group. Tests whether irradiance adds value beyond X02 and X01 on days 85-112, for example through net-of-solar draw.
  Result E5: scored days 85-112; reference MAE 1.305; candidate MAE 0.911; skill +30.2% (95% interval +18.0% to +41.7%); days won/lost/tied 23/5/0; skill per 7-day part: +16.3%, +51.8%, +23.4%, +26.4%
- E6: covariates [X01], reference [X02, X06], window 28 days; expected: no_change; because: Leave-one-out split of the E2 group. Wind has a weak prior, so this tests whether X01 is needed at all or is only riding along with X02 and X06.
  Result E6: scored days 85-112; reference MAE 0.902; candidate MAE 0.911; skill -1.0% (95% interval -5.6% to +2.5%); days won/lost/tied 12/16/0; skill per 7-day part: -4.5%, -6.0%, +3.4%, +3.5%

=== Call 3: round 3, days 1-126 observed ===
Notes: Round 3 (days 1-126). The budget is spent, so no experiments run this call. Summary of evidence: E2 (days 57-84): the weather group X02+X06+X01 helped, skill +30.9% (CI +12.4% to +48.0%). The leave-one-out splits on days 85-112 isolate the source. E5: X06 given X02+X01 gave +30.2% (CI +18.0% to +41.7%, 23 days won, 5 lost), positive in every 7-day part. E4: X02 given X06+X01 gave -3.6% (CI -8.6% to +1.4%). E6: X01 given X02+X06 gave -1.0% (CI -5.6% to +2.5%). So the group's value comes from irradiance, consistent with the measured draw being net of the rooftop array commissioned on day -9. No decay is seen in the X06 relationship across days 57-112, so there is no direct evidence of a regime change. The other nulls are older and weaker. E1 (X04 alone, -6.5%) and E3 (X05+X08+X03, -0.5%) cover only days 57-84. X07 was never tested. These nulls are provisional and dated; they could not be re-screened on days 113-126 because the budget ran out, which is a gap I acknowledge. Leaning towards a final selection of X06 only.
Beliefs:
- X01: rejected; cites: E2, E6; reason: Given X02+X06 it added nothing on days 85-112: -1.0% (CI -5.6% to +2.5%), 12 days won, 16 lost. Its share of the E2 group effect is not supported. Provisional, dated to days 85-112.

- X04: rejected; cites: E1; reason: Alone it showed no skill on days 57-84 (-6.5%, CI -24.9% to +8.2%). Provisional and dated. Not re-screened after day 84, so any later emergence is unknown.
- X05: rejected; cites: E3; reason: Its group showed no skill on days 57-84. Provisional and dated. Not re-screened on recent days.
- X06: accepted; cites: E2, E5; reason: Given X02+X01 on days 85-112: +30.2% (CI +18.0% to +41.7%), 23 days won, 5 lost, positive in all four 7-day parts. It carries the E2 group effect. This fits draw measured net of the new rooftop solar array.
- X07: untested; cites: none; reason: Never tested. It reports the same reservations as X04, which itself showed no skill in E1, but no direct evidence exists for X07.
- X08: rejected; cites: E3; reason: Its group showed no skill on days 57-84. Provisional and dated. Not re-screened on recent days.
